verdict.rationale: Poke documents its own automation features: Recipes let users "easily set up automations" (poke-docs-28), external services such as CI/CD or monitoring tools can trigger Poke through its API (poke-docs-2, poke-docs-1), and it markets itself as a proactive assistant that handles reminders (poke-probe-1, poke-docs-25). However, the docs never show how automations actually run unattended in the background, such as schedules, recurring jobs or event-driven workflows Poke executes on its own. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring background task execution, detail on autonomous trigger-action workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
